[ASSISTANT_SAID] 7. Pay attention to pace during easy runs, aiming for a conversational pace.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 8. Incorporate recovery runs after hard or long runs.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 9. Get enough rest and recovery, aiming for 7-9 hours of sleep each night.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 10. Mix up routes and terrains to keep training interesting.
